newsitem.title: UK: Moody's confirms Variable Funding asset backed CP.
newsitem.headline: Moody's confirms Variable Funding asset backed CP.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday it confirmed the Prime-1 rating for the Variable Funding asset backed commercial paper programme sponsored by First Union.

"The rating action follows a $100 million increase in Variable Funding's investment in a pool of prime auto loans. Variable Funding is now authorised to issue up to $481 million in commercial paper," Moody's said in a statement.

Moody's said the confirmation of the Prime-1 rating is based on the programme's liquidity facilities, programme-level credit enhancement, its various structural features and the ability of the programme's administrator, First Union.
"In addition to its investment in auto loans, Variable Funding owns a certificate backed by equipment lease obligations.

"The programme's lack of asset diversity is offset by substantial credit and structural supports at the asset pool level and at the programme level. Each asset pool is supported by pool specific credit enhancement in the form of asset overcollateralisation or subordination."
Moreover, each deal has performance-based triggers that require liquidation of the asset pool if credit quality deteriorates, Moody's said.

Credit support is provided through a letter of credit from First Union equal to 10 percent of the authorised amount of the program. The LOC is subject to a $25 million floor. First Union also provides liquidity support to the programme in the form of an asset purchase commitment.
